raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a logical error in comparing the dates. It stated that "Kingdom of Rock was released earlier than Was I the Wave? by about 4 years and 6 months." This is incorrect. April 26, 2011 (Was I The Wave?) is earlier than November 6, 2015 (Kingdom Of Rock). The difference is approximately 4 years and 6 months, but the direction of the comparison was flipped. The Planner incorrectly concluded that the later date (2015) was the earlier release.
